name: Fenris
description: Frozen homeworld of the Space Wolves Chapter. A death world of savage oceans and volcanic islands, its people are fierce warriors who follow the Old Ways.

name: Baal
description: Irradiated desert world and homeworld of the Blood Angels Chapter. The planet harsh conditions mean only the strongest survive to become Space Marines.

name: Armageddon
description: Heavily industrialised hive world that has withstood multiple Ork WAAAGH invasions. Its cities are massive hive structures rising above toxic ash wastes.

name: Octarius
description: A contested region where a massive Ork empire and a Tyranid Hive Fleet have been locked in brutal conflict for decades, consuming each other forces.

name: Eye of Terror
description: A vast region where the Warp and realspace overlap created by the Fall of the Eldar. Home to countless Chaos warbands and Daemon worlds.
